Coverage_Description: Preventive and basic restorative care: oral check-up/hygiene instruction, intra-oral X-ray (when needed), fluoride, fillings for new caries (anterior composite/posterior amalgam),; scaling & polishing is 1 visit (K21) or 2 visits (K12); excludes specialist care, wisdom/surgical/orthodontic extractions, and OPG/CT/large radiographs
pricing: HK$400/year (K21) or HK$570/year (K12) per member for 1 Sep 2025-31 Aug 2026.
customer requirement: CUHK student/staff/retiree membership type; eligible dependents may enroll
price structure: Fixed annual fee per member by plan tier (K21/K12), paid in full upfront; no prorated or mid-year refund
additional informations: Plan valid until 31 Aug 2026 (apply by 31 May 2026); enrollment takes about 10 working days; scaling booking should be made at least 2 months before expiry
